title: Glossy Braided Honey Challah
summary: An egg, honey and oil dough is kneaded until silky, risen, plaited into a single three-strand loaf, glazed twice and baked to 88-90 °C in the centre.
equipment: large bowl or stand mixer with dough hook
baking tray lined with baking paper

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
large egg, beaten with the reserved white, to glaze

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: Stir the flour, yeast and salt together. Whisk the honey, 2 eggs, yolk, oil and water, add to the flour and mix to a soft dough. Knead 10 minutes by hand or 6-7 minutes in a mixer until smooth and elastic.

steps.title: Rise
steps.text: Cover and leave 1.5-2 hours until doubled.

steps.title: Braid
steps.text: Divide into 3, roll each into a 40 cm rope slightly fatter in the middle, pinch the tops together and plait loosely. Tuck both ends under and lift onto the lined tray.

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: Brush with egg glaze, cover loosely and leave 45-60 minutes until puffy. Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Glaze again, add seeds if using and bake 30-35 minutes until deep brown and 88-90 °C in the centre, covering with foil after 20 minutes if needed.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool on a rack at least 30 minutes before slicing.

tips: Plait loosely; a tight braid tears as the loaf rises in the oven.
Two coats of glaze give the deepest shine.
Honey browns quickly, so check the colour after 20 minutes.
storage: Keep wrapped at room temperature and eat within 2 days, or freeze for up to 1 month. Refresh in a hot oven for a few minutes. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
